name: Ghost
label: Ghost Admin API
description: Official Ghost Admin API. OfficialApiNode. Auth Authorization: Ghost {jwt} (https://ghost.org/docs/admin-api/) — paste a short-lived Admin JWT, not the raw id:secret key. post_create / post_update take title/html/status/tags nested into posts[0] via bodyMap. extraHeaders send Accept-Version: v6.0. Never log the JWT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Writes send bodyFrom posts (Ghost envelope {posts:[{…}]}). Path {post_id}. Do not put admin_api_key here. Example: {"operation":"post_list","limit":15}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: post_create | post_get | post_list | post_update | post_delete | content_get | content_list.

schema.label: site_host
schema.description: Ghost site hostname only (no scheme). Interpolated as https://{site_host}/ghost/api/…. Example: example.com.

schema.label: content_api_key
schema.description: Ghost Content API key sent as query key= on content_get/content_list. Example: abc123contentkey.

schema.label: posts
schema.description:
One post object escape hatch merged into posts[0]. Named title/html/status/tags win. Example: {"title":"Hi","html":"

Hi

","status":"draft"}.

schema.label: source
schema.description: Admin write query source. Send html when using the html field (Ghost default is lexical). Example: html.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Browse page size. Ghost default 15; cap 100.

schema.label: title
schema.description: post_create / post_update title. Wired to posts[0].title. Required. Example: Hello world.

schema.label: html
schema.description: post_create / post_update HTML. Wired to posts[0].html. Set query source=html (Ghost lexical is default).

schema.label: status
schema.description: post_create / post_update status. Wired to posts[0].status. EXACT: draft | published | scheduled. Example: draft.

schema.label: tags
schema.description: post_create / post_update tags. Wired to posts[0].tags. Official [{name}] or [{slug}]. Example: [{"name":"News"}].

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (Ghost JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation. EXACT: post_create | post_get | post_list | post_update | post_delete | content_get | content_list. content_* are Admin GET /posts/ (not Content API).

configurationParameters.label: Admin JWT
configurationParameters.description: Short-lived Ghost Admin JWT (not the raw id:secret key). Sent as Authorization: Ghost {jwt} (official Admin API). OfficialApiNode cannot mint HS256 Admin tokens. StudioQuack secret only. Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Site Host
configurationParameters.description: Ghost site hostname only (no scheme). Admin API at https://{site_host}/ghost/api/admin. Example: example.com.

configurationParameters.label: Content API Key
configurationParameters.description: Content API key for content_get/content_list (?key=). StudioQuack secret. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 30. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
